status: conditional arithmetic only: hypothetical latencies and computation times, no measurement and no browser claim; no U14 branch and no P-C32-2 alternative is selected

model.requests: request 1 = eth_blockNumber; requests 2.. = pocol_getHeaders attempts; each request i takes latency[i-1] ms from its send to its reply
model.replies: one entry per pocol_getHeaders attempt: 'ok', 'busy:<ms>' or 'rate:<ms>'
model.PR: per-request: a request whose latency exceeds 10000 fails at send + 10000; retry sleep and computation are not counted
model.WL_a: whole load: one deadline at t = 10000 from the first send; reply waits, retry sleeps and computation up to the verdict all count
model.WL_b: whole load ending at the last reply: as WL_a, but computation after the last reply does not count
model.policyA: P-C32-2 alternative A: rate delays retried only if within [0, 2000]
model.policyC: P-C32-2 alternative C: any non-negative integral rate delay retried
model.retry: a valid -32021 is retried after exactly its delay, at most 3 times; the 4th valid -32021 gives viewIncomplete at its reply time
model.deadlineTieRule: no case places an event exactly at a deadline, so the inclusive/exclusive reading never decides an outcome

cases.note: under WL the deadline falls during the second sleep (5300 -> 10300); sleepMs is the PR value
